Spec findings

[P2, blocking] Recovery can publish contracts exceeding the retained 1 MiB bound — src/ergora/reference_task_creation.py:117 and :190.

Reachable scenario: an intent-only interrupted creation is restored with a member backend_reason exceeding 1 MiB and an identical reason in the saved definition override, with consistent envelope and intent digests. Smallest correction: apply the existing per-file serialization-size checks in shared record validation before publication, covering both compilation and loaded recovery records. Retain the aggregate intent bound and reject oversized material without truncation.
